title: The Weaver's Second Book of Mirage
summary: A second book for those who have the first primer and now layer one mirage behind another and hurl false shot.

title: A Study of the Doubled Body
summary: A study of casting a full second body beside the true one to take blows and to split a foe's attention.

title: Treatise on Layered Glamour
summary: A treatise on stacking glamour in thin sheets and on lifting a glamour that has been laid upon an ally.

title: The Phantasm Reader
summary: A reader of phantasm exercises in which a false thing is cast with enough weight to wound and to wake the sleeper.

title: Lessons in the Unseen Hand
summary: Lessons for the practiced illusionist on striking and gripping with a hand that the foe cannot see at all.

title: The Seeming Continued
summary: A long continuation of the first primer that widens the seeming to a sweep over many foes and a purge of false vision.

title: The Mirror-Hand Workbook
summary: A workbook of drills in which the hands and the qi are made to throw back a foe's own motion and shards of light.
